reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis proposes forming an Al2O3 scale on an Fe-B alloy, but the starting material is not specified to contain aluminum, making the formation of an Al2O3 scale through simple oxidation of the alloy physically impossible without an aluminum source.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and comparative, but it cannot falsify the hypothesis as written because the fundamental material requirement (aluminum in the alloy) is missing, making the experiment unexecutable.
reasons.usefulness: The concept of a pre-formed oxide barrier is relevant, but the critical flaw of omitting the aluminum source makes the hypothesis misleading and not useful for a researcher working on Fe-B components.
